name: Account Link Status Advice V 01
definition: SCOPE:|The AccountLinkStatusAdvice message is sent by the executing/servicing party to the instructing party to provide details about the processing of a request on account link reference data (create or update).||The instructing party - executing/servicing party relationship may be:|- Central Securities Depositories (CSD) who would like to publish account link static data, or|- a Corporate, or|- a Bank, or|- a Market Infrastructure, or|- a Market Data Provider.||USAGE:|Initiator: executing/servicing party||When processing information is negative - a failure occurred in applying the changes the message accordingly also delivers information about the reason why the creation or update could not be processed.|When the processing is successfully performed, the message includes the related account link identification.

MessageHeader.name: Message Header
MessageHeader.definition: Common business identification for the message.

AccountLinkIdentification.name: Account Link Identification
AccountLinkIdentification.definition: Provides a unique and unambiguous identification for the account link.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.
